title: Prompt-Payer Addition to the Early-Payment Discount Rate — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Prompt-payer schedule — Service Accounts and Repair Orders fleet terms.** The prompt-payer addition follows the account's payment history and terms:
- at least 8 payments received on the account within the last twelve whole months, account at Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30: 0.5% is added to the discount rate;
- at least 8 received, account at Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15: 0.25% is added;
- otherwise nothing is added.

**Window.** A record falls within the last twelve whole months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its date from the day the discount is worked out, a whole month being complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day, so records dated on that day count. Every payment received on the account counts, on any invoice.

| Payments in the last twelve whole months | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 |
|---|---|---|
| 8 or more | 0.5% added | 0.25% added |
| 7 or fewer | nothing | nothing |
